_note: Blocks are merged top to bottom; a later block wins. A 'stations'/'flavors' list scopes a block, an absent one matches all. Entries under 'stations' must be keyed by flavor (or 'ALL'). Keys starting with '_' are comments.

defaults_surf._note: Surface pulsing via coax: no attenuation, regardless of station.

defaults_sweep._note: The run ends with the sweep; seconds_per_run must not cut it short.

defaults_didaq_deep._note: The coincidence triggers fire on the deep calpulser and prevent phased-array trigger, so switch them off.
